hypotheses.justification: The definitions of E and ι₀ do not require irreducibility: AdjoinRoot has its algebra structure unconditionally, and ι₀ is defined using Cayley–Hamilton. After omitting this instance, unfold AdjoinRoot.root and ι₀; the quotient lift reduces definitionally to Polynomial.aeval γ₀ Polynomial.X, so Polynomial.aeval_X proves the equality. This works for every γ₀, including zero matrices and matrices with reducible characteristic polynomial.
